The '''Intruder''' was a simple model of [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]]. A mobile weapons platform, the Intruder was not truly a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] as it was not intelligent or capable of learning and complex processing. Intruders were often featured in [[Holodrama/Legends|holomovies]].<ref name="SWS" />
